facts.activity_file: isolating and depressuring a leaking system
facts.activity_series: responding to a loss of containment

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: unplanned release of chemical energy at TK-7101

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EMERGENCY_ISOLATION_ON_RELEASE: the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next critical control verification that the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment on TK-7101, LT-7101 and PSV-7101 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in responding to a loss of containment, specifically isolating and depressuring a leaking system. TK-7101 (product storage tanks) is in service for export product storage. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the emergency isolation and depressuring on loss of containment was in place but did not perform. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 3 June 2018 a potential incident was recorded on TK-7101, LT-7101 and PSV-7101 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during an intrusive maintenance task; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
